stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> open
    open --> finished: AI finish_task
    finished --> confirmed: User confirm
    open --> [*]: Delete
    finished --> [*]: Delete
    confirmed --> [*]: Delete
    note right of finished
        AI writes completion memo
        AI records created and changed files
        AI may later create linked QA entry
    end note
    note right of confirmed
        User acceptance only
        Optional future git commit id may be stored
    end note
